_comment: Atlas Growth / US residential standby-generator installers (ICP-generators.md). Same template as the signed-off US foundation config (personalize-config.json), trade tables rewritten for generators. Offer: 10 qualified generator estimate appointments that turn into install projects. Drafted 2026-09-25; 3-lead test run twice (operator edits 2026-09-25: electrician wording, HVAC caps, original offer line), then 7-lead, per SKILL STEP 7b. Nothing fills at full volume until both are signed off.
template:
Hi,

Noticed that you handle {{business_type}} in {{city}}.

We help you generate 10 qualified {{inspection_type}} that turn into paid {{project_type}} jobs, in under 30 days.

There's no pay unless I book you a qualified, confirmed {{inspection_singular}}.

Open to a 15-minute chat?

instructions.business_type: what this company leads with for homeowners, EXACTLY one of: standby generators, home generators, whole-home generators, home backup power, generator installation, HVAC and generators, solar and backup power (keep the capitals in 'HVAC'; everything else lowercase). Generator-led dealer -> the generator phrase the site itself uses most ('standby' / 'home' / 'whole-home'); 'home backup power' only when the site talks about backup power more than generators. An electrician (generators one service among many, or none shown) -> generator installation. An HVAC firm that also installs generators -> HVAC and generators. A solar firm that sells batteries/generators -> solar and backup power. Never a brand name (not 'generac generators'), never 'commercial', never 'electrical work'. Every company here is already on a generator dealer list or sells generators, so the site need not mention generators: decide by what KIND of business it is (business_name, google_types, site). A heating / air / HVAC / plumbing-and-heating business -> HVAC and generators. An electric / electrical / electrician business -> generator installation. Only a generator- or power-led business gets a generator phrase.
instructions.inspection_type: the first in-home visit, plural: 'generator' plus 'estimates', 'quotes' or 'assessments', according to which word the company itself uses for its free visit (default estimates). Never the word 'free', never 'in-home', never a brand name.
instructions.inspection_singular: the singular of inspection_type, e.g. generator estimate, generator quote.
instructions.city: ONLY if the 'city' known fact is blank: the city this company is based in, from the website. Otherwise repeat the known city exactly, without the state code.

rules: Decide business_type first. inspection_type always names the generator visit (the offer sells generator appointments even to an electrician, HVAC or solar firm). project_type is always 'install'. Operator 2026-09-25: electricians read 'generator installation'; the offer line is the original US email's, unchanged ('in under 30 days', no channel named); 'HVAC' stays capitalised.
